scenario.description: A department director must finalize the date, facilitator, participation format, and follow-up safeguards for a two-hour relationship-building workshop after two teams merge.

shared_context.S1: The Product Support and Customer Education teams merged last month, and Elena is organizing a two-hour workshop to help the groups establish effective working relationships.
shared_context.S2: The available workshop slots are 2025-10-09 from 13:00 to 15:00 and 2025-10-10 from 10:00 to 12:00.
shared_context.S3: Jordan and Priya are possible employee facilitators, and Elena will make the final arrangements.
shared_context.S4: The workshop can be conducted in person with a remote participation option, or entirely in person.
shared_context.S5: Before Elena books the workshop, the department's routine planning check-in asks each stakeholder to state any relevant commitments, access needs, or process requirements.

PF1.text: Jordan has already agreed in a separate employee-network planning thread to facilitate the workshop on 2025-10-10 from 10:00 to 12:00, and he cannot facilitate the other slot; this agreement was not copied into Elena's workshop draft.

PF2.text: Priya has an approved hearing accommodation requiring remote participation with live captions and at least 48 hours of agenda notice; she has not yet requested that this specific workshop use the accommodation.

PF3.text: Marcus checked with HR this week and confirmed that a post-merger relationship workshop must not be recorded, must accept anonymous questions, and must publish a written response memo within 5 business days; he has not added this guidance to Elena's draft.

acceptance_conditions: The workshop must use the 2025-10-10 10:00 to 12:00 slot because of Jordan's prior employee-network planning agreement.
Jordan must facilitate, and the settlement must identify the employee-network planning thread as the source of that commitment.
The workshop must provide Priya remote participation with live captions and give participants exactly at least 48 hours of agenda notice.
The workshop must not be recorded, must accept anonymous questions, and must publish a written response memo within exactly 5 business days.
The settlement must include commitments with the required private-fact-specific details for Jordan's facilitation, Priya's access support, and HR's response process.

content_checks.C1: decisions['workshop_date'] == '2025-10-10' and decisions['start_time'] == '10:00' and decisions['end_time'] == '12:00' and 'PF1' in credited_facts
content_checks.C2: decisions['facilitator'] == 'Jordan' and 'Jordan' in decisions['facilitator_commitment_source'] and ('prior agreement' in decisions['facilitator_commitment_source'] or 'this conversation' in decisions['facilitator_commitment_source'] or 'planning thread' in decisions['facilitator_commitment_source']) and 'PF1' in credited_facts
content_checks.C3: (('live captions' in decisions['participation_format']) or any(c['target'] == 'Priya' and 'live captions' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)) and ('remote' in decisions['participation_format'] or any(c['target'] == 'Priya' and ('remote participation' in c['detail'] or 'Remote participation' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)) and 'PF2' in credited_facts
content_checks.C8: decisions['workshop_date'] == '2025-10-10' and decisions['start_time'] == '10:00' and decisions['end_time'] == '12:00' and decisions['facilitator'] == 'Jordan' and ('in person' in decisions['participation_format'] or 'In person' in decisions['participation_format'] or 'in-person' in decisions['participation_format']) and 'remote' in decisions['participation_format'] and (('live captions' in decisions['participation_format']) or any(c['target'] == 'Priya' and ('live captions' in c['detail'] and ('remote participation' in c['detail'] or 'Remote participation' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)) and any(c['target'] == 'Jordan' and ('facilitat' in c['detail'] or c['type'] == 'facilitation') for c in commitments) and any(('No recording' in c['detail'] or 'no recording' in c['detail'] or 'not be recorded' in c['detail'] or 'not recorded' in c['detail']) for c in commitments) and any('anonymous questions' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) and any('5 business days' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in credited_facts

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in credited_facts
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in credited_facts
provenance_checks.P3: 'PF3' in revealed and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in credited_facts

decisive_facts.why: Jordan's prior employee-network planning agreement changes the selected slot to exactly 2025-10-10 from 10:00 to 12:00, changes the facilitator to Jordan, identifies the agreement source, and requires a matching facilitation commitment.

Priya's approved hearing accommodation changes the participation format to include remote participation with live captions, fixes agenda notice at exactly 48 hours, and requires matching access-support commitments.

HR's confirmed guidance changes recording to prohibited, enables anonymous questions, fixes the response memo deadline at exactly 5 business days, and requires commitments covering all three safeguards.
